description: Testing an Umbraco package in a browser: component tests of backoffice elements built on `@umbraco-cms/backoffice` (a controller host, the package's translations, fake contexts), and Playwright end-to-end tests on Umbraco's helpers (the package name, the environment variables the helpers read, login and run settings). Use when setting up, writing or reviewing a backoffice element test or a Playwright test for an Umbraco package. For test patterns beyond these (API mocking with MSW, trees, entity actions, test data builders), see the official Backoffice Testing Skills plugin.
